course.title: Operations Research and Systems Analysis
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Customers arrive at a sale counter manned by a single person according to a Poisson (12) process with a mean rate of 20 per hour. The time require to serve a customer has an exponential distribution with mean of 100 seconds. Find-
(i) the probability that the counter is busy
(ii) the average waiting time of a customer
(iii) the average number of customers in the queue

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
